mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.actor_id AS actorId, actor.nickname AS actorNickname, n.type, n.video_id AS videoId, v.title AS videoTitle, n.comment_id AS commentId, n.content, n.is_read AS isRead, n.create_time AS createTime FROM notification n INNER JOIN sys_user actor ON actor.id = n.actor_id LEFT JOIN video v ON v.id = n.video_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY n.is_read ASC, n.create_time DESC, n.id DESC
